ev.q: Investigators identified 18 varicella cases among persons with illness onset during April 1--June 22; 14 patients resided in the same apartment complex
14 patients resided in the same apartment complex
Of the 18 cases, 17 were confirmed* and one was probable.
Two patients developed severe complications (pneumonia and ataxia with postviral sensory neuritis) and were hospitalized.
ADPH invited CDC to assist in outbreak investigation and control.
All the cases were in previously healthy young adults living in an apartment complex
